name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1500: The macOS app bundle was a FIFTH version surface outside the v1489 parity gate: install-tvd.sh hardcoded 787 while the installed apps advertised 1379.3 and the tree was v1499, so re-running the installer would have regressed the advertised version by 600. Both bundles restamped to 1499 in place - they are unsigned, so this costs no re-grant - and the installer now derives the number from tv_diablo.py like every other stamp. A gate proves it can never be typed again.
